text: 我是來自上海市奉賢區教育學院的劉綺老師。我們將開始我們的課程,以一個有趣的活動為主題。讓我們嘗試一下有關職業的詞彙。請準備好,並自行閱讀。你準備好了嗎?Alice,你會試試嗎?Dairy farmers care for their cows near the hill.A voice actor brings joy to listeners.The poor tour guide got lost in the woods.Firefighters fight fire without fear near burning fields.Good job!Remember the sounds we learned in the unit?Can you identify the repeated sound in each tongue twister?And in the last sentence,there and near share the sound air.Well done!Reading tongue twisters is an interesting way to help us practice our pronunciation.And you can try to read more after class.We have been discussing a lot about jobs these days.Do you still remember the big question of this unit?Yes, it's what do you know about jobs?Now that we have completed the unit,let's think about how our understanding has grown.Take a moment to consider.What new information have you learned about different jobs?How have your views of jobs changed?Which job do you think is the most surprising?I learned that jobs can be divided into four types.Practical jobs,public services,and private benefits.The first one is called a job that can be divided into three.The second one is called a job that can be divided into four.So the third one is called a job that can be divided into four.The fourth one is called a job that can be divided into three.我发现,工作可以分成四种类型专业工作、公司工作、艺术工作和技术工作这些都可以展示出有很多不同的工作有不同的技术和好意我还发现,每个工作都有自己的挑战例如,演员可能会很受欢迎他们很努力地工作,并且有很忙碌的日子很多人都不可能期待我现在看到工作不同我曾经以为有些工作很简单例如,做烹饪人士或达布娃拉但是现在,我发现他们用很多技术和努力我还曾经以为有些工作比较重要但是现在,我知道每个工作都重要以达布娃拉为例他们不受欢迎但他们的工作是重要的人们尊重他们我被达布娃拉对我最惊讶我以前也不知道他们的工作他们的工作很棒,很喜欢也证明你们能够努力努力的出现任何工作好一点!当然,你们都学懂了很多各种工作的重要性你们证明了每个工作有自己的职业和价值不同工作的人都在努力去改善生活在我们的学习课We also explored old jobs from the past.We looked at their titles,duties,and the reasons for disappearing.There's always more to learn about jobs.To help you gain a deeper understanding of jobs and careers around you,the Career Guidance Workshop has asked you to complete a project.Lisa had a lot of fun with her project.So she wrote a diary to share her experience with us.Please read her diary and answer the following questions.It's in your worksheet.Task 1.Time is up, Peter and Alice, which roles are you playing?I'm acting as the Taylor, and Alice is acting as Lisa.Great, can you share your interview with us?Hello, my name is Lisa, and I'm doing a project about different jobs in the neighborhood.May I ask you some questions about your work?Hello Lisa, I'm John Green.Sure, I'd be happy to help.What would you like to know?Thank you, Mr.Green.Can you tell me what you're working on right now?I'm fixing a pair of pants for an elderly lady.They were too long, so I'm making them shorter.That sounds interesting.What kind of tools do you use for your work?I use several tools, but my favorite is my magic scissors.They are very sharp and help me work quickly.What do you enjoy most about being a Taylor?I enjoy the challenge of solving problems with clothing and making sure everything fits perfectly.It's also great to see how happy people are when their clothes are just right.How did you become a Taylor?Did you have special training?Yes, I went to a tailoring school and trained under experienced tailors.It took a lot of practice, but I love what I do.Thank you for sharing your work with me, Mr.You're welcome.It was a pleasure talking to you.Great job, Peter and Alice.Your interview was excellent.You asked smart questions about Mr.Green's work.For example, you asked what are you working on?What kind of tools do you use?What do you enjoy most of being a Taylor?And how did you become a Taylor?You were polite when you started the conversation, and you remembered to say thank you at the end, which was very nice.Keep up this great work in your future interviews.Remember to always be polite.Ask thoughtful questions and listen carefully.This will help you learn even more about different jobs.What do you think of being a Taylor?Do you think it's a good job?I think being a Taylor is a great job.It's cool to help people with their clothes and see them happy when their clothes fit perfectly.It looks like it takes a lot of skills and creativity, so it must be really enjoyable to do.All in all, it seems like a really good job.I like your idea.Now, I'd like you to write a short passage about the job with the title, a or an job in my eyes.In the blank, you can add an adjective you prefer to describe the job.If there's another job you are interested in, you can write about that instead.Just make sure to include a topic sentence and supporting details.It's in your worksheet, task two.由 Amara.org
